newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN UNIWEAR SAYS SHARE OFFER FULLY SUBSCRIBED.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN UNIWEAR SAYS SHARE OFFER FULLY SUBSCRIBED.

text.p: Belgian textile holding company Uniwear said in a statement on Wednesday its offer of 1,000,000 new shares at 288 francs a share had been fully subscribed.

As a result, it had closed the subscription period a day early. The offer started on March 3 and had been due to run to March 27. Details on the distribution would be published with in five working days.
Uniwear said most of the shares had been subscribed to by private investors. Connie Inc, reference shareholder of Uniwear, had subscribed to 104,166 of the new shares.
Connie represents the interests of Uniwear chief executive officer Andrea Cattaneo Della Volta. Prior to the operation, Connie held 475,738 shares, or 24.92 percent, in Uniwear.
